narrative:
October is on track to close at WD+6, against WD+11 in September. Full-volume feed ingestion saves 2.5 days and agentic reconciliation 1.5. Intercompany auto-agreement saves one more day, drafted flux commentary half a day. The Sport 1 POS cut-over adds half a day back.

The close gate is ready for CFO review. Feeds are 96.8% complete, 93.8% of value is auto-reconciled, and the NOK 84.7M still unmatched is fully assigned. Only 14 items are above the NOK 0.5M line limit. Anton Sport, Group and Intersport accounting are signed off or in final review; Sport 1 and e-commerce are pending.

Every number on this page links back to the source records and to the agent or person who changed it. That is the evidence the leadership business case needs: a close that does not break under volume, without adding consultants.

signals.title: September close — Business Central API time-outs
signals.excerpt: The Business Central API could not handle the data volume during the first month-end close on the new ERP. Finance fell back to extracting from the Data Lake to finish the close.

signals.title: Leadership business case — data platform
signals.excerpt: A 10-slide leadership deck is being prepared to justify modernising the data platform. Month-end close reliability is the lead argument.

signals.title: Reliance on external consultants
signals.excerpt: Close workarounds depend on consultant scripts with limited documentation. Knowledge leaves when consultants roll off.
